info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Interactions-v5-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Interactions API facilitates the retrieval of data regarding potential interactions between prescribed medications. It provides healthcare providers and pharmacists with access to detailed information about how different prescriptions may interact with one another, ensuring patient safety and effective medication management. Common use cases include checking for drug interactions prior to prescribing or dispensing medication, thereby preventing adverse effects and optimizing therapeutic outcomes. This API is essential for applications aimed at improving patient care and decision-making in pharmaceutical services.

get.description: Retrieve potential interactions for a specified prescription to ensure patient safety and optimize therapy. This endpoint helps healthcare providers understand the implications of prescribed medications and aids in making informed treatment decisions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve potential interactions for prescriptions. It allows the client to specify the relevant prescription data to check against known drug interactions.

200.description: Request completed successfully with interaction details.

ListPharmacyPrescriptionsInteractionsReq.description: A request body for fetching prescription interactions. This string represents any necessary criteria or parameters needed to query the interactions effectively.
